senses.gloss: प्र-ज See under प्र-√ जन्.
प्र-˚ज mf(आ)n. bringing forth, bearing (see अ-प्रज)
प्र-˚ज m. a husband, L.
प्र-˚जा f. See below.
प्रजा॑ f. (ifc. f(आ). ; cf. प्र-ज above) procreation, propagation, birth, RV.; AV.
offspring, children, family, race, posterity, descendants, after-growth (of plants), RV. &c. &c.
a creature, animal, man, mankind
people, subjects (of a prince), ib.
seed, semen, VS. (cf. -निषेक)
an era, Divyāv.
प्र-जङ्घ m. N. of a monkey and of a Rākṣasa, R.
प्र-जङ्घा f. a partic. portion of the lower part of the thigh, Jātakam.
1. प्र-जज्ञि mfn. (for 2. See under प्र-ज्ञा) able to beget (see 1. अ-प्रजज्ञि).
2. प्र-˚ज॑ज्ञि mfn. (for 1. See प्र-√ जन्) knowing, conversant with, ŚBr.
प्र-˚जन m. begetting, impregnation, generation, bearing, bringing forth (rarely n.), Mn.; MBh.
one who begets, generator, progenitor, BhP.
प्र-जाना f. the place of bringing forth, AitĀr.
प्राजन m. a whip, goad, Gobh.; KātyŚr., Sch. (also प्राज, Gṛhyās.)
प्र-˚जनार्थम् ind. for the sake of procreation, Mn. ix, 96.
प्र-˚ज॑नन mfn. begetting, generating, generative, vigorous, VS.; ŚBr.
प्र-˚ज॑नन n. the act of begetting or bringing forth, generation, procreation, birth, production (lit. and fig.), AV. &c. &c.
generative energy, semen, TS.; TBr.; ŚrS.
the male (RV.; Br.) or female (L.) generative organ
offspring, children, BhP.
= प्र-गम, or प्र-गत, L.
प्र-˚जनन—काम mfn. desirous of begetting or bringing forth, Kauś.
प्र-˚जनन—कुशल mfn. skilled in midwifery, Suśr.
प्र-˚ज॑नन—वत् (˚ज॑नन-), possessing generative power, AV.
प्र-˚जनयितृ॑ m. a generator, begetter, progenitor, TS.; Br.
प्र-˚जनिका f. a mother, L.
प्र-˚जनिष्णु॑ mfn. generative, procreative, producing, ŚBr.; Kāṭh. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 2, 136)
being born or produced, W.
growing, standing (as corn), ib.
प्र-˚जनिष्यमाणा f. about to bring forth, being near the time of delivery, Suśr.
प्र-˚जनु॑ m. f. the organ of generation (of females), TBr.
प्र-˚जनुक (?) m. the body, L.
प्र-जानुक m. the body.
प्र-˚जस् (ifc.) = ˚जा (cf. दुष्-, बहु-)
प्र-˚जस् m. N. of a son of Manu Auttami, VP.
प्र॑-˚जात (प्र॑-), mfn. born, produced, RV.; &c.
प्र॑-˚जाता (आ), f. a woman who has borne a child, ŚrS.; MBh. &c. (cf. ऋत-).
प्र॑-˚जाति (प्र॑-), f. generating or generative power, generation, production, bringing forth, delivery, Br.; ŚrS.; BhP.
(प्र॑-) = उप-नयन, initiation with the sacred thread (as causing second birth), BhP., Sch.
प्र॑-˚जाति (प्र॑-) m. N. of a prince, MārkP. (v.l. प्र-जानि)
प्र-˚जाति—काम (प्र॑-) mfn. desirous of propagation, AitBr.
प्र-˚जाति—मत् (प्र॑-) mfn. containing words relating to generation, ib.
प्र-˚जा˚त्य्-आनन्द (प्र॑-) m. the joy of propagation, BhP.
प्रजा—कर m. a symbol. N. for ‘a sword’ (!), L.
प्रजा—कार m. the author of creation, Hariv.
प्रजा—कल्प m. the time of creation, Hariv. (perhaps w.r. for पुरा-क्˚).
प्रजा॑—काम (˚जा॑-), mfn. desirous of offspring, AV. &c. &c.
प्रजा॑—काम (˚जा॑-) m. desire of o˚, ML.
प्रजा—गुप्ति f. protection of subjects, Āpast.
प्रजा—घ्नी See -हन्.
प्रजा—चन्द्र m. ‘people's moon’, honorific N. of a prince, Rājat.
प्रजा—तन्तु m. a line of descendants, a race, TUp.; BhP.
प्रजा—तीर्थ n. the auspicious moment of birth, BhP.
प्रजा—दा f. ‘granting offspring’, N. of a species of shrub, L.
प्रजा—दान n. procreation of children, Āpast.
‘people's gift’, silver, L.
प्रजा—द्वार n. ‘gate or means of obtaining progeny’, N. of the sun, MBh.
प्रजा—धर mfn. supporting creatures (said of Viṣṇu), Viṣṇ.
प्रजा˚ध्यक्ष m. (˚जाध्˚) ‘surveyor of c˚’, N. of the sun, MBh.
of Kardama and Dakṣa, BhP.
प्रजा—नाथ m. ‘lord of c˚’, N. of Brahmā or Manu, Prab.
of Dakṣa, Bh.
= -प, Ragh.; Rājat.
प्रजा—निषेक m. infusion of semen, impregnation, offspring, Ragh. xiv, 60.
प्रजा˚न्तक (˚जान्त्˚) m. ‘destroyer of creatures’, Yama, god of death, L.
1. प्रजा—प mfn. (for 2. See प्र-√ जप्) protecting subjects, Nalac.
प्रजा—प m. a prince, king, L.
2. प्र-˚जाप mfn. (for 1. See under प्र-जा) muttering prayers, praying, Nalac.
प्रजा—पति (˚जा-), m. ‘lord of creatures’, N. of Savitṛ, Soma, Agni, Indra &c., RV.; AV.
(˚जा-) a divinity presiding over procreation, protector of life, ib.; VS.; Mn.; Suśr.; BhP.

(˚जा-) lord of creatures, creator, RV. &c. &c. (N. of a supreme god above or among the Vedic deities [RV. (only x, 21, 10); AV.; VS.; Br.] but in later times also applied to Viṣṇu, Śiva, Time personified, the sun, fire, &c., and to various progenitors, esp. to the 10 lords of created beings first created by Brahmā, viz. Marīci, Atri, Aṅgiras, Pulastya, Pulaka, Kratu, Vasiṣṭha, Pracetas or Dakṣa, Bhṛgu, Nārada [Mn. i, 34; cf. IW. 206 n. 1], of whom some authorities count only the first 7, others the last 3)
(˚जा-) a father, L.
(˚जा-) a king, prince, L.
(˚जा-) a son-in-law, L.
(˚जा-) the planet Mars, a partic. star, δ Aurigae, Sūryas.
(˚जा-) (in astrol.) = 2. काल-नर, q.v.
(˚जा-) a species of insect, L.
(˚जा-) N. of sev. men and authors, Cat.
प्रजा—पती (˚जा-), f. a matron, lady, Divyāv.
N. of Gautama Buddha 's aunt and nurse (with the patr. Gautamī, the first woman who assented to his doctrines), Lalit.
प्राजापती f. N. of AV. v, 2, 7; Kauś.
प्रजा॑—पति—गृहीत (˚जा॑-प्˚), mfn. seized by Prajā-pati, VS.
प्रजा—पति—चरित n. N. of wk.
प्रजा॑-पति—चित (प्रजा॑प्˚), mfn. heaped up by Prajāpati, MaitrS.
प्रजा—पति—चिति॑ f. P˚'s slayer, ŚBr.
प्रजा—पति—दत्त m. N. of a man, Pat.
प्रजा—पति—निवासिनी f. N. of a Gandharvī, Kāraṇḍ.
प्रजा—पति—पति m. ‘lord of the P˚s’, N. of Brahmā, BhP.
N. of Dakṣa, ib.
प्रजा॑—पति—भक्षित (˚जा॑-प्˚), mfn. eaten by P˚, VS.
प्रजा॑-पति—मात्र mfn. having the measure of Prajāpati, JaimUp.
प्रजा॑—पति—मुख (जा॑-प्˚), mfn. having P˚ as head or chief, ŚBr.
प्रजा—पति—यज्ञ m. ‘sacrifice to P˚’, the procreation of children enjoined by law, VP.
प्रजा—पति—लोक॑ m. P˚'s world (situated between the sphere of Brahmā and that of the Gandharvas), ŚBr.
प्रजा—पति—शर्मन् m. N. of a man, L.
प्रजा॑—पति—सृष्ट (˚जा॑-प्˚), mfn. created by P˚, AV.; ŚBr.
प्रजा—पति—स्मृति f. N. of wk.
प्रजा—पति—हृदय n. ‘P˚'s heart’, N. of a Sāman, ŚrS. (also प्रजा॑पतेर्-हृ॑द्˚, ŚBr.; TS.)
प्रजा—पतिक m. endearing form of प्रजापति-दत्त, Pat.
प्रजा—पत्य w.r. for प्राजापत्य.
प्रा—जाप˚त्य See s.v.
प्राजापत्य॑ mf(आ॑) is coming or derived from Prajā-pati, relating or sacred to him, AV. &c. &c.
प्राजापत्य॑ m. a descendant of Pr˚ (patr. of Pataṃ-ga, of Prajāvat, of Yakṣma-nāśana, of Yajña, of Vimada, of Viṣṇu, of Saṃvaraṇa, of Hiraṇya-garbha), RAnukr.
(with or scil. विवाह or विधि) a form of marriage (in which the father gives his daughter to the bridegroom without receiving a present from him), ĀśvGṛ. i, 6; Mn. iii, 30 &c.

(with or scil. कृच्छ्र or उपवास) a kind of fast or penance (lasting 12 days, food being eaten during the first 3 once in the morning, during the next 3 once in the evening, in the next 3 only if given as alms, and a plenary fast being observed during the 3 remaining days, Mn. xi, 105), Yājñ. &c.
प्राजापत्य॑ m. (with शकट, also n.) the chariot of Rohiṇī, N. of an asterism, Var.; Pañcat.
प्राजापत्य॑ m. (with or scil. तिथि) the 8th day in the dark half of the month Pauṣa, Col. (˚त्याश् चत्वारः प्रस्तोभाः N. of Sāmans, ĀrṣBr.; superl. ˚त्य-तम, Kapiṣṭh.)
a son born in the Pr˚ form of marriage, Viṣṇ.
a Kṣatriya and a Vaiśya, GopBr.; Vait.
N. of the confluence of the Gaṅgā and Yamunā, L. (cf. MBh. i, 2097)
(with Jainas) N. of the first black Vāsudeva, L.
प्राजापत्य॑ n. generative energy, procreative power, AV.; TS.
(with or scil. कर्मन्) a partic. kind of generation in the manner of Prajā-pati, MBh.; Hariv.
a partic. sacrifice performed before appointing a daughter to raise issue in default of male heirs, W.
the world of Prajāpati, MārkP.
(with or scil. नक्षत्र or भ) the asterism Rohiṇī, MBh.; Var.
(also with अक्षर्य, प्रयस्-वत् and माधुच्छौदस) N. of Sāmans, ĀrṣBr.
प्राजापत्या (आ), f. patr. of Dakṣiṇā, RAnukr.
giving away the whole of one's property before entering upon the life of an ascetic or mendicant, W.
N. of a verse addressed to Prajā-pati, ĀpGṛ.
(with शकटी) = m. n. with शकट, MW.
प्रजा—पद्धति f. N. of wk.
प्रजा—परिपालन n. the protection of subjects, Viṣṇ.
प्रजा—पाल m. ‘protector of creatures’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, MBh.
a prince, king, ib.; Rājat.
N. of a king, VarP.
प्रजा—पालन n. = -परिपालन, Mn. ix, 253 &c.
N. of wk.
प्रजा—पालि m. ‘protector of creatures’, N. of Śiva, Śivag. (cf. गो-पालि).
प्रजा—पाल्य n. the office of protector of the people, royal office, R.
प्रज्˚आमृतत्व (˚जामृ˚) n. perpetuity of posterity, AV.
प्रज्˚आर्थम् and प्रज्˚आर्थे (˚जार्थ्˚), ind. for the sake of offspring, MBh.
प्रज्˚आर्थम् and प्रज्˚आर्थे (˚जार्थ्˚), ind. for the sake of offspring, MBh.
प्रजा॑—वत् (˚जा॑-), mfn. having or granting offspring or children, prolific, fruitful, RV. &c. &c.
प्रजा॑—वत् m. N. of a Ṛṣi and his hymn, ĀśvGṛ.
(with the patr. प्राजापत्य) supposed author of RV. x, 183; Anukr.
प्रजा॑—वती (अती), f. pregnant, BhP.
(ifc.) bringing forth, mother of MārkP. (cf. वीर-)
a brother's wife, Ragh.
the wife of an elder brother, L.
N. of a tutelary deity of the Su-mantus, VarP.
of a Surāṅganā, Siṃhās.
of the wife of Priya-vrata, MārkP.
प्रजा—वरी f. v.l. for -वती (f. of prec.), MānGṛ.
प्रजा—वि॑द् mfn. bestowing or granting progeny, AV.
प्रजा—वृद्धि f. increase or abundance of offspring, Āpast.
प्रजा—व्यापार m. care for or anxiety about the people, Siṃhās.
प्रजा—व्यृद्ध-पशु-व्यृद्ध mfn. one who has ill luck with his children and cattle, ĀpŚr.
प्रजा—शान्ति f. N. of wk.
प्रजा—स॑नि mfn. = -विद्, VS.
प्रजा—सृज् m. creator of beings, N. of Brahmā and Kaśyapa, Rājat.
father or king, Śiś. i, 28, Sch.

प्रजा—हित mfn. favourable to or good for offspring or subjects
प्रजा—हित n. water, W.

प्र-जहित॑ mfn. (irreg. fr. the pres. stem) quitted, abandoned, RV. viii, 1, 13 (applied to a fire that has been abandoned, TāṇḍBr.; ŚrS.)
प्रा—जहित m. = प्र-ज्˚
प्रा—जहित m. a Gārhapatya fire maintained during a longer period of time, ŚrS.
प्रजेप्सु mfn. desirous to obtain offspring, MW.
प्रजेश m. ‘lord of creatures’, N. of the god presiding over the procreation of offspring, BhP.
‘lord of the people’, a prince, king, Ragh.; BhP.
प्रा—जेश See s.v.
प्राजेश mf(ई)n. (fr. प्रजेश) sacred to Prajāpati
प्राजेश n. the Nakṣatra Rohiṇī, VarBṛS.
प्रजेश्वर m. ‘lord of creatures’, creator (cf. प्राजेश्वर)
a prince, king, Hariv.; Ragh.
प्रा—जे˚श्वर See s.v.
प्राजेश्वर mf(ई)n. (fr. प्रजेश्वर) id., ib.
प्रजेहा f. desire of offspring, MBh.
प्रजोत्पत्ति f. the raising up of progeny, MW.
प्रजोत्पत्त्य्-आनुपूर्व्येण ind. according to seniority, Hir.
प्रजोत्पादन n. id., Suśr.
प्र-˚जानि m. N. of a prince, Pur. (cf. जाति).
प्र-˚जायिनी f. about to bring forth, Suśr.
(ifc.) bearing, bringing forth, a mother of (cf. वीर-).

प्र-˚जय॑ m. victory, conquest, ŚBr.

प्र-˚जल्प m. prattle, gossip, heedless or frivolous words (esp. words used in greeting a lover), L.
प्र-˚जल्पन n. talking, speaking, Pañcat.
प्र-˚जल्पित mfn. talked, spoken, ib.

प्र-˚जल्पित n. spoken words, talk, MBh.

प्र-˚जव॑ m. haste, rapidity, RV.
प्र-˚जव॑ mfn. rapid, swift, Gal.
प्र-˚जागर mfn. one who wakes, waking, MBh. &c.
प्र-˚जागर m. a watchman, guardian, BhP.
N. of Viṣṇu, MBh.
waking, watching, attention, care (also pl.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
waking up (intr.), Kām.
प्र-˚जागरा f. N. of an Apsaras, MBh.
प्र-˚जागरण n. being awake, Suśr.
प्र-˚जागरूक mfn. wide awake, Śrīkaṇṭh.
प्रजापयितृ॑ m. w.r. for प्रदाजयितृ॑, TBr.
प्र-√ जि P. -जयति, to, win, conquer, AV.; &c.
प्रज्जि m. N. of a man, Rājat.
प्र-˚जित् mfn. conquering, defeating, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 61, Sch.
प्रजित mfn. driven, impelled, urged on (prob. w.r. for प्राजित; see तोत्त्र-, दण्ड-).
प्रजिन m. wind, air (also spelt प्रजीन), L.

प्र-जिहीर्षु mfn. (Desid. of √ हृ) being about to strike or hit, Rājat.

प्र-˚जीविन् m. N. of a minister of Megha-varṇa (the king of the crows), Pañcat.

Caus. -जावयति, to set in rapid motion, dart, shoot (arrows), Nir. ix, 17.
प्र-˚ज॑वम् ind. hastily, rapidly, TS.
प्र-˚जवन mfn. running very quickly, Uttarar.
प्र-˚जवित mfn. driven on, impelled, MBh.; Hariv.; R.
(ifc.) urged on, incited, summoned by (= प्र-चोदित), Hariv.
प्र-˚जविन् mfn. hastening, rapid, swift, Kād.; Kathās. (Pāṇ. iii, 2, 156)
प्र-˚जविन् m. a runner, courier, express.

प्र-√ जॄ P. -जीर्यति, to be digested, Suśr.
प्र-˚जीर्ण mfn. digested, Car.
प्रज्जटिका f. a kind of Prākṛt metre, Col.
1. प्र-ज्ञ mfn. = प्र-ज्ञु, L.
2. प्र-ज्ञ mf(आ)n. (for 1. See above) wise, prudent, MāṇḍUp.
(ifc.) knowing, conversant with (cf. निकृति-, पथि-)
प्र-ज्ञा f. See col. 2
प्र-ज्ञा॑ f. wisdom, intelligence, knowledge, discrimination, judgement, ŚBr. &c. &c.
device, design, ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
a clever or sensible woman, W.

a partic. Śakti or energy, Hcat.
(with, Buddh.) true or transcendental wisdom (which is three fold, Dharmas. 110), MWB. 126; 128
the energy of Ādi-buddha (through the union with whom the latter produced all things), MWB. 204.

intelligent, wise, clever, KaṭhUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
प्रा—ज्ञ॑ m. a wise or learned man, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
intelligence dependent on individuality, Vedāntas.
a kind of parrot with red stripes on the neck and wings, L.
प्राज्ञ &c. See p. 702, col. 1.
प्रा—ज्ञा f. intelligence, understanding, L.
2. प्र-ज्ञ॑—ता (˚ज्ञ॑-), f. knowledge, ŚBr.
प्र-˚ज्ञात mfn. known, understood, found out, discerned, known as (nom.), well-known, public, common, notorious, Mn.; MBh. &c.
प्रा—ज्ञ—ता f. (Mn.) wisdom, learning, intelligence
प्र-˚ज्ञक See अकृत-प्रज्ञक.
प्र-˚ज्ञप्त mfn. (fr. Caus.) ordered, prescribed (cf. वैद्य-)
arranged (as a seat), Divyāv.
प्र-˚ज्ञप्ति f. teaching, information, instruction, BhP.
an appointment, agreement, engagement, W.
arrangement (of a seat), Divyāv.
(with Jainas) a partic. magical art personified as one of the Vidyā-devīs, Kathās. (L. also ˚ती)
